commands:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('.github/workflows/ci.yml')
s = p.read_text()
old = '''      - name: Format
        run: |
          pnpm format
          git diff
          git diff --quiet

      - name: Upload formatted LED sources
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: formatted-led-sources
          path: |
            apps/mobile/e2e/led-settings.spec.ts
            apps/mobile/src/__tests__/shelly-led-settings.test.tsx
            apps/mobile/src/flows/installations/deviceLed.ts
            apps/mobile/src/screens/deviceLedCopy.ts
            packages/shelly-client/src/__tests__/plugsUi.test.ts
            packages/shelly-client/src/plugsUi.ts
'''
new = '''      - name: Format
        run: pnpm format:check
'''
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('expected temporary format workaround not found')
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
PY

pnpm exec prettier --write .github/workflows/ci.yml apps/mobile/e2e/led-settings.spec.ts apps/mobile/src/__tests__/shelly-led-settings.test.tsx apps/mobile/src/flows/installations/deviceLed.ts apps/mobile/src/screens/ShellyLedSettingsCard.tsx apps/mobile/src/screens/deviceLedCopy.ts packages/shelly-client/src/__tests__/plugsUi.test.ts packages/shelly-client/src/plugsUi.ts packages/shelly-client/src/index.ts packages/shelly-client/src/model.ts apps/mobile/src/screens/InstallationDetailScreen.tsx apps/mobile/src/screens/TimeInstallationDetail.tsx
grep -q 'run: pnpm format:check' .github/workflows/ci.yml && ! grep -q 'Upload formatted LED sources' .github/workflows/ci.yml && grep -q 'responsive-visual-audit' .github/workflows/ci.yml

git add .github/workflows/ci.yml apps/mobile/e2e/led-settings.spec.ts apps/mobile/src/__tests__/shelly-led-settings.test.tsx apps/mobile/src/flows/installations/deviceLed.ts apps/mobile/src/screens/ShellyLedSettingsCard.tsx apps/mobile/src/screens/deviceLedCopy.ts packages/shelly-client/src/__tests__/plugsUi.test.ts packages/shelly-client/src/plugsUi.ts packages/shelly-client/src/index.ts packages/shelly-client/src/model.ts apps/mobile/src/screens/InstallationDetailScreen.tsx apps/mobile/src/screens/TimeInstallationDetail.tsx
git commit -m 'Finalize native Shelly LED settings'
